label: Local-first tooling
summary: Local-first tooling refers to running models and processing locally, without making API calls to external services. In Maaike's work it appears as a constraint or requirement: specifically, text embeddings for the knowledge garden should run locally. It is a practical prerequisite rather than a topic explored in its own right.
how_maaike_uses: Maaike frames local-first tooling as a filter when surveying embedding models for the garden's semantic linking project. The survey of embedding models is explicitly focused on models that run locally without API calls, so local-first is a selection criterion shaping which options are even worth considering.
